content: Poloꞌa, Nafaluꞌnimogitapaꞌe afoꞌnimogitapaꞌeꞌmo geꞌnimo afiyo. Nagaefeꞌmo huꞌapaeꞌmo, ani kava nehiye ina kava nehiye huꞌa nehaya gelefeꞌmo mago gemo hugesuve, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Yu vayaꞌai gefatiꞌmo huꞌnigeꞌa afiteꞌapaeꞌmo magoꞌe huꞌa ge osuꞌa afaꞌa afiꞌnae.

Poloꞌa, Yu vekamo maiꞌneꞌna Silisiya kotega taonimo agiꞌamo Tasasi taonifiꞌmo itaꞌnimoꞌmo alino natetegeꞌnaeꞌmo eꞌna mani Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo ko siꞌna maiꞌnove. Maiꞌnogeno Gameliyeloꞌa muki laginago vayaꞌai keꞌaepa gemo alino naya maleꞌnigeꞌna alagepa huꞌna afiꞌnove. Lapakaemo hemenimo nehaya agufa kavaꞌmo huꞌna Goti kateꞌmo nayamukiki huꞌna uꞌnove.
Nagaemo saufa mono gemo akame nehaya vayaꞌmo faligae, huꞌna huteꞌna naini huꞌna apateteꞌna ve aꞌnemo kalavusi huꞌna apateꞌnove.

Mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya vekaꞌe muki kanisole vayaꞌmogiꞌeꞌmo huꞌnova kavaꞌnimo ago nageꞌnayanageꞌa afaꞌa nava gemo huꞌa lapa paigae. Apakaemo mago avoꞌmo kaeꞌa namiꞌnageꞌna alininuꞌna Namasakasi taonifiꞌmo Yu vayaꞌmo apamisuvafeꞌmo kaeꞌa namiꞌnae. Nagaemo ani vayaꞌmo kalavusi huꞌna apateteꞌna Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo apavaleliꞌna esugeꞌa lusi hosu apakafu yaꞌmo alisayafeꞌmo uꞌnove.
Poloꞌa Goti mafaꞌnemo hamaleꞌnove, huno huꞌniya gemae
Nagaemo Namasakasi taonimo haopaleꞌmo neꞌugenoꞌaeꞌmo yegemo haineno namotule aeꞌniya afinaꞌmo lusi ha le yaꞌmoꞌa kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo nahaopaleꞌmo aeno ha leꞌnigeꞌnaeꞌmo
nagaemo mopafiꞌmo asagauꞌna aiꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo afuvana, Solo, Solo, huno, Na kava higeka nagaefeꞌmo kaini huka neꞌnatane, huno nafi geꞌnigeꞌnaeꞌmo,
Ala kava nene, huꞌna, Ina lagae, huꞌna afi geꞌnogenoꞌaeꞌmo, Nagaemo Yesuꞌnamo Nasalasa taonifi vekamo kaini huka neꞌnatana vekamo maiꞌnove, huno naha paiꞌniye.
Nagaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌa uꞌnaya vayaꞌmogimo ha le yaꞌmo ageꞌnayaꞌmonanafa naha paiꞌniya geꞌamo oꞌafiꞌnae.

Ala kava nene, huꞌna, Na kava hisuve, huꞌna afi geꞌnogeno Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa naha painoꞌaeꞌmo, He tika Namasakasi taonifiꞌmo ugenoꞌao ani taonifiꞌmo Gotiꞌa ani agufa kavaꞌmo hugane, huno lekana paino kateꞌniya kavafeꞌmo kaha paigiyanagi uvo, huno naha paiꞌniye.
Ha le yaꞌmoꞌa nagaeteꞌmo aeno ha leꞌnigeno naulagalaꞌmo aeno ali huꞌnigeꞌa nagaeꞌeꞌmo lokaeꞌa uꞌnaya vayaꞌmogi nayate aliniꞌa Namasakasi taonifiꞌmo uꞌa nateꞌnae.
Mago vekamo agiꞌamo Ananayasiꞌa mono vekamo lagae keꞌaepa gemo akame nehiya vekamo maiꞌnigeꞌa muki Namasakasi taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnaya Yu vayaꞌmogi agiꞌaleꞌmo aliꞌa asaga huꞌa ateꞌnae.
Agaemo nahaopaleꞌmo eno he tinoꞌaeꞌmo, Konagaꞌnimo Solo, huno, kaulagalaꞌmo ageka ayako, huno naha paiꞌnigeꞌnaeꞌmo ageꞌna ayakeꞌnove.

Agaemo, Laginago vayaꞌai Gotiꞌapimoꞌa lekana paino kateꞌniye. Gotiꞌa hogoteno, ani kavaꞌmo huguve, huno agesa afiꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo afiteka aliꞌyaꞌamo alino alagepa kavaꞌmo nehiya vekamo ageteka agaiꞌa avayafati gemo afisanafeꞌmo lekana paino kateꞌniye.
Kagaemo aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌalikaeꞌmo ageꞌnana kavaꞌe afiꞌnana geꞌeꞌmo muki vayaꞌaifeꞌmo aeka hakalo huka hapa paigane.
Na kava higeka afaꞌa maiꞌnane. He tika aniꞌmo faleteka Ala kava neꞌmo agiꞌalefeꞌmo ge hugenoꞌao hosu kavakamo aeno kalo paeno kateno, huno naha paiꞌniye.
Gotiꞌa Polofeꞌmo, alu nofi vayaꞌaitegamo uka aeka hakalo huka hapa paiyo, huno naha paiꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌniya gemae
Nagaemo aiꞌna atagi neꞌneꞌna Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo alopa mono nopiꞌmo haiꞌna nunumuꞌmo nehuꞌnaeꞌmo alagamuna agegekana huꞌna ageꞌnove.
Ageꞌnovana Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa, Malage huka Yulusalemu taonifatiꞌmo ataleka uvo. Apakaemo nagae nava gemo aeka hakalo huka hapa paisana gemo oꞌafigayanagi ataleka uvo, huno naha paiꞌniye.
Naha paiꞌnigeꞌna, Ala kava nene, Ago afiꞌnayana nagaemo uꞌna Yu vayaꞌai mono nopiꞌe nopiꞌeꞌmo haiꞌna kagaefeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehaya vayaꞌmo kalavusi huꞌna apatege apatege huꞌnove.

Mago vayaꞌmogimo kava gemo aeno hakalo huno hapa nepaiya vekamo agiꞌamo Sitiveniꞌa amagiꞌnaya afinaꞌmo apakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi maiꞌneꞌna, he, kanalene, huteꞌna amagiꞌnaya vayaꞌai kukenaꞌapileꞌmo yagaiꞌna maiꞌnove, huꞌna ha paiꞌnogenoꞌaeꞌmo
Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa, Afaꞌa uvo. Alu nofi vayaꞌaitegamo aliꞌna katesugekaeꞌmo afaꞌa uvo, huno naha paiꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Apakaemo Poloꞌa huꞌniya gemo afime afime neꞌvagenoꞌaeꞌmo Poloꞌa ani gemo hapa paiꞌnigeꞌa afiteꞌa alopa gefatiꞌmo huꞌapaeꞌmo, Ani agufa vekamo ma mopafi oꞌmaigiyanagi amagita ataleyo, huꞌa huteꞌa
apano aeteꞌa apaipamo lusi kava huno leꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo kukenaꞌapimo aliꞌa asagiꞌa atalege mumusopamo aliꞌa kokuꞌnapi yaga auꞌa atalege huꞌnae.

Ati vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya hogote vekamoꞌa, Lagae yafa nopiꞌmo avalelita haitapa Yu vayaꞌmogi apano neꞌaeꞌa amagigefeꞌmo huꞌnaya gemo aepaꞌamo laha paisigeta afisunafeꞌmo amagiyo, huno hapa paiꞌniye.

Hapa paiꞌnigeꞌa avaleliꞌa haiꞌa amagisayafeꞌmo nofi kiꞌa ateꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo Poloꞌa mago vekamo haopaleꞌmo he tino maiꞌniya vekamo ati vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya vekaeꞌmo, Lapakae keꞌaepa getapimoꞌa lapakaefeꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Lomu vayaꞌmogi yagaiꞌa neꞌataya vekamo agoti hutapa oꞌateꞌnaya vekamo amagiyo, huno lapa paiꞌnifiye, huno afi geꞌniye.

Yagaino neꞌapateya vekamoꞌa ani gemo afitenoꞌaeꞌmo uno yagaino neꞌapateya hogote vekaeꞌmo, Nehana kavafeꞌmo alagepa huka kagesa afiyo. Ani vekamo Lomu vayaꞌmogi yagaiꞌa neꞌataya vekamo maiꞌniye, huno ha paiꞌniye.
Yagaino neꞌapateya hogote vekamoꞌa uno Polofeꞌmo, Lomu vayaꞌmogi yagaiꞌa nekataya vekamo maiꞌnapiye, huno afi geꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo, He, huno ha paiꞌniye.

Yagaino neꞌapateya hogote vekamoꞌa, yagaiꞌa natesayafeꞌmo alopa miyaꞌmo ago apamiꞌnove, huno huꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo, Miya faiꞌnanaꞌmonanafa nagaemo itaꞌnimoꞌmo alino nateꞌniya afinatetiꞌmo yagaiꞌa neꞌnataya vekamo maiꞌnove, huno ha paiꞌniye.

Ati vayaꞌmogi agenoka huꞌa afi gesayafeꞌmo eꞌa maiꞌnaya ati vayaꞌmogimo ani gemo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo afaꞌa ataleꞌnae. Yagaino neꞌapateya hogote vekamoꞌa, Vaehae, huno, Lomu vayaꞌmogimo yagaiꞌa neꞌataya vekamo seli nofitetiꞌmo kiꞌna ateꞌnove, huno agesa afiteno lusi kava huno koli huꞌniye.

Egaꞌamo yagaino neꞌapateya hogote vekamoꞌa Yu vayaꞌmogi Polofeꞌmo hosu kavaꞌmo huꞌniye, huꞌa huꞌnaya gemo aepaꞌamo afisiyafeꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, nofiꞌmo hatu maetapa ateyo, huno hapa paiteno mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌe kanisole vayaꞌefeꞌmo ge hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Etapa alita anupa huta maiyo, huno ge huꞌniye. Eꞌa aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maiꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo Poloꞌa avalelineno apaulagaleꞌmo alino he tino ateꞌniye.
